name: SD Muhammadiyah Program Khusus Kottabarat Surakarta

notes.id: Biaya masuk mencakup uang pengembangan, seragam, dan pengembangan laboratorium. SPP mencakup fieldtrip, outing, kemah, LKSD, katering, snack, dan ekstrakurikuler.
notes.en: Entry fee covers development, uniforms and lab development. Tuition covers field trips, outings, camp, workbooks, catering, snacks and extracurriculars.
